scope: Read-only independent opportunity table and longest-path proof verification; no new account or upstream
independent_algorithm: Longest compatible-entry path ending at each eligible completed cycle, enumerating all previous compatible nodes rather than earliest-entry greedy
proof_review: Eligible entries relax cash/lot/reset restrictions and allow arbitrary skipped days, so every actual permitted entry remains included.
For each fixed entry an earlier legal sell cannot delay future entry under max(E+H+1,sell+1); any real path maps to a feasible relaxed path with at least as many closed cycles.
Reserved early model permits arbitrary E+1 earliest sell regardless of support/P, so upper bound applies to both R/P; fixed model begins sell at E+H.
Beyond-window unsold cycles excluded; all witness entries and public exit times fit the evaluated window.
H18 bound80/81<83 excludes uniform H18 under unchanged entry/reservation/execution. H15 bound96/97>=83 does not establish an actual feasible strategy path, real frequency or return.
Does not exclude mixed/conditional horizons or changed reservation; no economics or candidate registration performed.
